name: pushpace
description: PushPace fitness tracker: NestJS API + Next.js web app

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
